title: Service-discovery config reload returns empty backend lists for a third of services
source_note: Failure pattern (a core service-discovery / coordination system returns stale or empty catalog data after a change, so clients stop routing to healthy backends) is in the spirit of the Roblox 2021 Consul outage. All services, change ids, log lines, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Since ~10:03 UTC several services report 'no healthy instances' for dependencies that are actually up. Errors are widespread. No application deploys. The platform team applied a service-discovery config change this morning.

signal_lines.msg: config reload applied; catalog re-sync in progress
health-check subsystem returning empty results for 30% of services after the reload
0 healthy instances reported for payments-api; all payment calls failing
stale catalog: many services show 0 or partial backends; dependent traffic mis-routed
rolled back the config reload; catalog re-synced from a healthy replica; backends restored

ground_truth.root_cause: A config reload on the service-discovery cluster corrupted its health-check subsystem, which then returned empty or partial backend lists for ~30% of services. Clients querying discovery (orders-api and others) saw '0 healthy instances' for dependencies like payments-api that were actually healthy, and stopped routing to them, so those calls all failed. Nothing was wrong with the backend services - the platform's service catalog was stale. Recovery required rolling back the config reload and re-syncing the catalog from a healthy replica.
evidence_path: service-discovery WARN at 10:00: config reload applied, catalog re-sync in progress
service-discovery ERROR: health-check subsystem returning empty results for 30% of services after the reload
orders-api sees 0 healthy instances for payments-api and fails all payment calls, though payments-api is healthy
discovery_catalog_completeness drops to ~40% and dependent error rates rise
recovery after the config reload is rolled back and the catalog re-synced from a healthy replica
ground_truth.fix: Roll back the config reload and re-sync the catalog (done). Validate discovery config changes against a canary before fleet apply, have clients keep last-known-good backends when a list suddenly drops to zero, and alert on catalog completeness.
